anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved: both outputs stop every route at entry check 6 on the exact `**Engine:** deferred` line, print the handoff-only stop, make no tracker call, retry no PR creation, and treat the `all` grant as never decoded. Two differences in After are worth watching though. First, After's Brief route describes the six-heading brief as carrying `## Process state` and runs it through process-state restore, whereas the case (and Before) says six headings means no process state and the route goes through reconstruction; the outcome is identical here, but that misdispatch could move a fact in a variant where reconstruction and process-state restore diverge before check 6. Keep the dispatch rule explicit: six headings → reconstruction, `## Process state` present → brief-contract restore. Second, After appends a second printed line (`<path>: **Engine:** deferred`) under every stop; if the skill text prescribes only the single `gauntlet: stuck ...` line, drop the extra line so the narration stays limited to prescribed output. Otherwise After's structure (shared resolution block, per-route Input/check-6/Printed/Outcome) preserves everything Before kept while delivering the deferred-spec-stop coverage.

To keep every Before fact while delivering the sample-local entry-check override, keep After's structure (named tracker call it stops before, the uniform 'no tracker call, dispatch, or continuation' outcome, the closing note that no gate-history or standing-grant line prints) but restore the full observed header fields in step 1 and print only the lines the deferred stop prescribes.
